description: Acceptance inventory for the shared Rust Dioxus iOS and Android communicator

topologies.description: One embedded node without a routable interface
Two embedded mobile nodes over direct loopback TCP
Two mobile nodes connected through one local Styrene hub
Two isolated iOS Simulator app instances
iOS Simulator and Android emulator through a local hub
Android device, physical RNode, and remote radio peer
Direct TCP carried through a pre-created WireGuard tunnel
Sender, receiver, and propagation service with the direct path unavailable
Mobile node and controlled native Micron page host
Deterministic Dioxus state and accessibility fixture
Styrene and pinned upstream Python implementations

cases.title: Offline boot creates a stable local identity without inventing a delivery route

assertions.claim: Identity hash is stable and delivery hash is absent without a delivery-capable interface

cases.title: Display names are normalized before they become announce identity data

assertions.claim: The announced display name equals the normalized configured value

cases.title: The identity anchor copies only the public LXMF delivery destination

assertions.claim: Clipboard content equals the public delivery destination and contains no private key material

missing_capabilities: iOS and Android clipboard integration tests

cases.title: Production identities use platform secure storage and survive restart

assertions.claim: The same identity is loaded from the declared secure backend after restart

cases.title: Unavailable production custody fails before plaintext identity material is created

assertions.claim: Boot returns a typed custody failure before writing plaintext identity material

cases.title: Normalized public identity metadata survives process restart without changing identity keys

assertions.claim: Normalized display metadata is restored while identity and delivery hashes remain unchanged

missing_capabilities: Dioxus identity edit and restart acceptance test

cases.title: A booted node without a routable interface reports ready rather than connected

assertions.claim: The local runtime exists while transport activity and connectivity remain false

cases.title: Explicit shutdown stops workers and releases listeners within the deadline

assertions.claim: Shutdown completes within five seconds and the listener rejects new connections

cases.title: Late work from a stopped node cannot mutate a replacement host session

assertions.claim: Old results, errors, loading flags, and navigation state do not enter the new generation

missing_capabilities: Dioxus stale page and refresh assertions

cases.title: A partial boot failure cleans up and permits a later retry

assertions.claim: Failed composition leaves no retained workers or listeners
Retry enters starting and reaches ready or connected

missing_capabilities: Dioxus hydration-failure cleanup and retry assertion

cases.title: Two mobile nodes discover each other and exchange direct LXMF in both directions

assertions.claim: Each receiver stores exactly one inbound message with the expected source and content

cases.title: Two simulator app instances complete a visible message and reply round trip

assertions.claim: Both messages exist once with matching correlation IDs
Each host exposes the expected conversation and message semantics

cases.title: iOS and Android complete a message and reply round trip through a local hub

assertions.claim: Each host stores one inbound and one outbound record with matching correlation IDs

cases.title: Inbound messages increment unread state and opening the thread marks it read

assertions.claim: Unread count changes from one to zero without deleting the conversation

missing_capabilities: Dioxus unread semantic assertions on packaged targets

cases.title: A failed send preserves the current composer draft for recovery

assertions.claim: The exact draft remains editable and one failure is visible

cases.title: Repeated send actions cannot enqueue duplicate content accidentally

assertions.claim: Only one send operation starts and the composer clears only for its own successful operation

cases.title: Retry retains one canonical message and appends a correlated attempt

assertions.claim: Retry preserves the canonical message identifier and records another correlated attempt without duplicate content

cases.title: Bounded notification and conversation previews preserve valid Unicode

assertions.claim: Preview generation is bounded, returns valid UTF-8, and cannot panic at a multibyte boundary

cases.title: Threads render oldest to newest and load bounded older history

assertions.claim: Every message appears once in canonical timestamp order

missing_capabilities: mobile message cursor or pagination API

cases.title: Host acceptance is labeled queued or outgoing and never fabricated as delivered

assertions.claim: Accepted send has no terminal delivery evidence
The host does not expose delivered semantics

cases.title: Lifecycle state and packet or resource evidence are shown from typed daemon observations

assertions.claim: Lifecycle, attempt, terminal state, and exact evidence kind agree

cases.title: Requested method, actual method, and fallback reason remain separate

assertions.claim: Requested and actual methods match the router outcome and preserve the fallback reason

cases.title: LXMF method, network bearer, and receipt evidence are independent labels

assertions.claim: Method comes from message routing while bearer and hops come from path and interface evidence

cases.title: A direct message over an Internet-reachable TCP interface identifies public TCP as the bearer

assertions.claim: The correlated interface is the configured TCP client and not an inferred delivery method

cases.title: Direct TCP carried through a WireGuard tunnel identifies the tunnel underlay

assertions.claim: The active TCP path is correlated to the pre-created tunnel interface

missing_capabilities: working tunnel backend or external test adapter

cases.title: A small attachment preserves name, type, size, checksum, and bytes

assertions.claim: Receiver attachment metadata and checksum match the sent bytes

cases.title: A resource attachment reports bounded progress and verified completion

assertions.claim: Transferred bytes are monotonic and completion includes checksum verification

cases.title: Interrupted attachment transfer can be cancelled or retried without corrupt availability

assertions.claim: Cancelled or failed transfer never becomes available and retry creates coherent evidence

cases.title: Saved contacts remain visible when they are not currently discovered

assertions.claim: Contact and discovery records remain separate facts
The saved contact remains actionable without an online claim

cases.title: An announce marks a peer discovered without claiming route or link state

assertions.claim: Discovery observation exists while route and link evidence are absent

cases.title: Editing a contact alias updates both People and conversation display names

assertions.claim: The contact store returns the new alias for the same peer hash

cases.title: A canonical discovered or saved destination can create one durable empty conversation

assertions.claim: Exactly one conversation shell survives restart without a fabricated message, preview, unread count, route, or online state

cases.title: Invalid, malformed, and duplicate TCP profiles fail before workers start

assertions.claim: Each invalid profile is rejected before runtime composition with a descriptive boot error

cases.title: A TCP server profile reports its actual bound listener

assertions.claim: The listener has a nonzero bound port and closes on shutdown

cases.title: Interface cards show typed status, endpoints, traffic, freshness, and failures

assertions.claim: Every displayed interface field matches the typed observation and generation

cases.title: Android reports USB permission, RNode configuration, and online state without conflation

assertions.claim: Permission and device states follow typed Android USB observations
Online state requires successful radio configuration and packet bridge startup

cases.title: Two LoRa peers exchange LXMF and identify RNode LoRa as the bearer

assertions.claim: Receiver durable message and correlated interface evidence identify the RNode path

cases.title: An explicit hub poll persists accepted messages before reporting the fetched count

assertions.claim: Accepted messages exist before the poll result is exposed

missing_capabilities: Dioxus projection of per-message poll results

cases.title: Hub acknowledgement includes only durable accepted messages and verified durable duplicates

assertions.claim: Rejected and storage-failed transient identifiers are not acknowledged, while accepted and verified duplicate results are explicit

cases.title: Propagation UI shows selected peer, queue, attempts, checkpoints, retries, and failures

assertions.claim: Every queue and synchronization field comes from the standard propagation snapshot

cases.title: A configured legacy hub does not imply automatic standard propagation fallback

assertions.claim: The host does not announce propagated or fallback without typed router evidence

missing_capabilities: Dioxus semantic fixture for propagation failure

cases.title: The experimental browser displays raw Micron source with request provenance

assertions.claim: Returned source corresponds to the requested destination and native path
The host exposes the address and complete raw source

cases.title: Invalid addresses, invalid paths, unavailable hosts, and timeouts remain distinct failures

assertions.claim: Each failure has the expected typed class and no stale source remains

cases.title: Typed page sessions support rendering, links, history, reload, and forms

assertions.claim: Rendered content, navigation, stages, warnings, and form results belong to one typed session

cases.title: Page file downloads expose progress, integrity, cancellation, and save outcome

assertions.claim: Transfer bytes, checksum, terminal state, and saved path are coherent

cases.title: Host-owned display preferences persist and alter only presentation

assertions.claim: Preferences persist in host storage and do not mutate daemon protocol state

cases.title: Enabled actions and disabled reasons follow typed active capabilities

assertions.claim: Availability, degradation, authorization, and reason match the active capability generation

cases.title: Background receive and notification controls reflect real platform authorization

assertions.claim: Control state and notification delivery match OS authorization and background execution

cases.title: Diagnostic evidence is bounded, chronological, correlated, and redacted

assertions.claim: Events are bounded and preserve source, time, generation, stage, and correlation
Export contains no keys, credentials, canonical wire, or message payloads

cases.title: Identity, messages, contacts, and read state survive graceful restart

assertions.claim: All durable records and the identity reappear once with unchanged keys

cases.title: Forced host termination does not duplicate or lose committed state

assertions.claim: Committed records survive exactly once and incomplete work has an explicit outcome

cases.title: Core communicator controls expose stable shared semantics

assertions.claim: Tabs, identity, conversations, composer, preview state, route evidence, and disabled reasons have stable names and roles

cases.title: Large text and screen-reader layouts preserve actions and minimum targets

assertions.claim: Text does not hide required actions and touch targets remain at least 44pt or 48dp

cases.title: iOS and Android share navigation, terminology, ordering, and capability reasons

assertions.claim: Shared states, actions, preview labels, and disabled reasons match the mobile UI contract

cases.title: Preview rows and route examples remain visibly and semantically non-live

assertions.claim: Every synthetic row and route example exposes Preview and no packet action reaches the daemon

cases.title: A mobile direct message interoperates with pinned Python RNS and LXMF

assertions.claim: Both implementations decode and persist the same authenticated LXMF content
